products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Create a funny festive scene with Santa's little helper appearing to be stuck head first inside the Christmas tree.
- The animated Elf's leg wriggles when switched on, adding movement and playful character to your Christmas tree.
- Attach the integrated clip to the centre pole of your Christmas tree, then arrange the branches around the Elf.
- Battery powered by 3 x AA batteries, allowing flexible placement without an additional mains cable running through the tree.
- Indoor Christmas decoration measuring 15 cm high, 35 cm long and 13 cm wide, ideal for adding playful character to your festive display.
- Elf's Stuck wriggling Christmas tree decoration.
- Dimensions: 15 cm high, 35 cm long and 13 cm wide.
- Battery operated with 3 x AA batteries for cordless placement in your Christmas tree.
- The integrated clip secures the decoration to the centre pole of your Christmas tree for straightforward installation.
- Made from polyester and plastic, this decoration is designed for indoor use only.

## Information
Add a playful touch to your festive display with this Elf's Stuck Christmas tree decoration from Samuel Alexander. Designed to look as though a mischievous Elf has fallen head first into the tree, it features legs sticking out between the branches for a humorous seasonal effect. Switch it on to make the Elf's leg wriggle as though he is trying to escape. The integrated clip attaches to the centre pole of your Christmas tree, while the battery-powered design avoids the need for an additional cable. Requires 3 x AA batteries. Suitable for indoor use only. Dimensions: 15 cm high, 35 cm long and 13 cm wide.
